name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-annotator
description: Quartz 5 plugin that shows annotations written with Obsidian's Annotator plugin, and mirrors their source documents. See CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled into the plugin or installed here: the page body's vnodes must be the host's Preact's, and the pipeline library, which this plugin inlines, runs the site's transformers with the host's unified and vfile (#98). The Viewer's browser bundle carries a copy of Preact, built from the same install.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: build.mjs bundles dist/, the Viewer's browser chunks and its stylesheet, whose PDF.js text layer PostCSS prefixes into the Viewer's block, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks it all against ADR-0003. Our libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005). pdfjs-dist is pinned exactly: PDF.js throws if its API and worker differ, and the text-layer CSS is copied from this version. @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs).

quartz.name: cgc-annotator
quartz.//frames: Registered under the frame's own name, `cgc-annotation`, which the page type declares (docs/adr/0004).
